# synology_afp (Resource)

AFP file-sharing configuration. Destroy releases management without disabling the service.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_afp.main
  id = "afp"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_afp" "main" {
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `apply_default_permissions` (Boolean) Apply DSM default UNIX permissions.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable AFP.
- `quick_disconnect` (Boolean) Disconnect idle clients quickly.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Singleton identity and import identifier: afp. Destroy only releases Terraform management; it never resets DSM settings.
